notes.privacyNote: Features depend on eligible content and availability. Scrum practice, AI lesson assistance, standalone scenario tiers and tier-specific exam analytics are not yet available. The displayed AI token allowances are proposed, not live credit limits.
notes.billingNote: AI token allowances are proposed; the current AI wallet uses credits. Cancel renewal anytime; access continues until the paid term ends.

profile-import.title: Bring your experience with you.
profile-import.description: Add your LinkedIn link or upload your own LinkedIn PDF / profile export. Review imported details before saving.

profile-import.dialogDescription: Import your own supported résumé or LinkedIn export and review before saving.
profile-import.dialogBody: Upload a supported file, review extracted details and choose what to save. Files are not synchronized automatically with LinkedIn.
